company.name: Vellum
company.tagline: On stillness, attention, and writing for the long hours.
company.description: Vellum is a curated bi-monthly digital magazine for slow readers — long-form literary essays paired with considered fashion editorials. Each issue gathers three writers from three cities; the publication ships every other month and keeps an archival cadence rather than a feed.
company.target_audience: Readers in their 30s-50s who subscribe to The Drift, Apartamento, and Aesop's reading list; people who own physical books and consider design a literary discipline.
key_messages: Issue No. 27 — three writers, three cities.
On stillness, attention, and writing for the long hours.

accent.name: Terracotta
accent.usage: Quiet emphasis, single dots, color shift on emphasis

headings.notes: Editorial serif. Starts loose (8-16px) then tightens during emphasis.

accent.notes: Used for institutional micro-labels, all caps, very wide tracking.

visual_style.overall_aesthetic: Editorial restraint. Generous negative space, asymmetric staging, soft hairline dividers. Feels like a magazine spread, not a dashboard.

shapes.border_radius: 2-4px max on cards (almost sharp); never pill

effects.shadows: barely present; only on hero cards (low-opacity, large-blur)

visual_style.imagery: Single-color portrait cards labeled with city. No photographs. Hairline dividers. Single accent terracotta dots used as quiet punctuation.

components.buttons: Hairline ghost only; serif label, terracotta on hover
components.cards: Cream rectangle with 1px taupe stroke and tiny serif label below
components.data_viz: Not used. Vellum is not data-driven.

brand_voice.language_style: Sentence-cased serif copy. Periods, not exclamations. Single sentences carry whole paragraphs of weight.

motion_design.philosophy: Editorial restraint — character-by-character reveals, generous holds, asymmetric staging, soft mask wipes, no overshoot

extraction_metadata.confidence_notes: Brand spec is fictional but fully specified. Warm paper-tone palette confirmed. Times/Georgia serif stack chosen for portable render fidelity.
